messages:
jamie: Hey team, sudden 401 invalid_api_key from our production webhook after I pasted the new key into the env var. No other changes. Anyone seen this recently?
lee (support): Sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact Authorization header (redact middle) or a few chars of the key? Also which SDK / curl are you using?
jamie: Using curl from CI runner. Header we send: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_45–n3QwX7...` (i redacted middle). Notice the chunk after sk_live_45 looks right to me. Getting 401 with body: `{\"error\":{\"type\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"message\":\"Invalid API key provided\"}}`
lee (support): Hmm there's an odd character between 45 and n3 — can you paste that fragment raw in triple backticks so we can inspect codepoints?
jamie: Sure:```sk_live_45–n3QwX7```
ben: Looks fine at glance, but that middle char is suspicious. Might be an en-dash or non-ascii punctuation if copied from an email client. Can you run a quick Python ord check on that char? e.g. `print([ord(c) for c in '45–n'])`
sam: Also which email/source did you copy from? Some HTML emails convert -- to an en dash automatically.
jamie: I copied from an onboarding email forwarded internally. Ran the check:```python>>> s='45–n'>>> [hex(ord(c)) for c in s]['0x34', '0x35', '0x2013', '0x6e']```
lee (support): Yup 0x2013 is EN DASH (unicode 8211). Our keys are ASCII only. The en dash replaced the ASCII hyphen (0x2d). That explains the 401 — server sees a different key string.
jamie: Oof. I guess my mail client auto-replaced the hyphen. Any quick fix without rotating the key?
ben: You can transform the env var on the runner before use: `export API_KEY=$(echo "$API_KEY_RAW" | tr '–' '-' )` but some shells/versions of tr might not handle unicode char in single quotes. Safer to do a small python substitution: `API_KEY=$(python - <<'PY'\nimport sys\ns=sys.stdin.read()\nprint(s.replace('\\u2013','-'))\nPY <<"$API_KEY_RAW")`
sam: Or just copy the key directly from the dashboard (Account -> API keys) — that gives you exact ASCII hyphen. We'll add a note to docs.
jamie: Confirmed: replaced the char and curl now returns 200. Thanks. Also filing internal note to always copy from dashboard, not forwarded email.
lee (support): Good to hear. I'll mark this as resolved — adding a short KB blurb for support responses: common copy-paste transforms (en-dash, smart quotes) cause invalid_api_key 401. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deployment webhook retry succeeded (200)
jamie: Thanks all :raised_hands:
